title: tessera.config.json
description: Where an app keeps its own design-system parts, for the Tessera tools. It sits at the repo root, next to pnpm-workspace.yaml in a monorepo. Every path is relative to this file.

$schema.description: The schema that gives this file its editor hints: ./node_modules/@drizztdourden08/tessera/tessera.config.schema.json

package.description: The workspace package that holds the shared parts, such as @archipelia/design. No default.

stories.description: The folder of the gallery stories. Default: stories.

overrides.description: The file that builds the TesseraOverrides the app hands to TesseraProvider. No default.

apps.description: Per app settings. Each key is an app folder, relative to this file, such as apps/desktop. Its value overrides or extends the settings above for that app; usually only parts.views.

path.description: A path relative to this file.

folders.description: A folder or glob, or a list of them, relative to this file. tessera new writes into the first one unless --into picks another.

parts.description: The folders of each kind of part the app builds.

primitives.description: App primitives, the rare part only this app needs that writes raw HTML. Default: src/primitives.

composites.description: App composites, the rare part only this app needs built from primitives. Default: src/composites.

compounds.description: Compounds, which draw one app concept from Tessera parts. Default: src/compounds.

views.description: Views, the screens that own state. Usually set per app under apps. Default: src/views.

css.description: The theme stylesheet that sets the palette seeds. Default: src/theme.css.

palette.description: The data-palette name of the app palette, such as archipelia. No default.

ai.description: The usage files and the ai/ folder built from them.

usage.description: report lists the parts with no usage file and passes; enforce fails on them. Default: report.

out.description: The folder pnpm ai writes. Default: ai.

tree.description: The module that holds the decision tree of the app parts. No default.

gallery.description: The StoryLite gallery. Read only when @storylite/storylite is installed.

title.description: The title at the top of the gallery menu.

port.description: The port the gallery serves on.

review.description: The file that records the review of each gallery page.

app.description: What this app changes from the settings above. Objects merge key by key; any other value replaces.

stories.description: The folder of the gallery stories of this app.

overrides.description: The overrides file of this app.
